description: Combine the calibrated Smith-Waterman results, identify the single marginal IpaH4.5 outlier, and plot z-score distributions for IpaH4.5 versus true-TBC and non-TBC-GAP controls
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
PROV = "/agent/jobs/67602354-ea98-4aaa-b433-3bd20d603be1/provenance"
df = pd.DataFrame(json.load(open(f"{PROV}/_swres_part1.json")) + json.load(open(f"{PROV}/_swres_part2.json")))
tbc = df[~df["query"].str.contains("NEL-family")].copy()
nel = df[df["query"].str.contains("NEL-family")].copy()

summ = tbc.groupby("query").agg(n_targets=("z","size"), median_z=("z","median"), max_z=("z","max"),
                                n_z_gt5=("z", lambda s:(s>5).sum()),
                                n_beat_all_shuffles=("exceeds_all_shuffles","sum")).reset_index()
print(summ.to_string(index=False), "\n")
print("IpaH4.5 top 3 TBC targets by z:")
print(tbc[tbc["query"].str.startswith("IpaH4.5")].nlargest(3,"z")[["target","tlen","score","null_mean","null_sd","z"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nSensitivity control (IpaH4.5 vs Salmonella NEL-family): median z =", round(nel["z"].median(),1))
tbc.to_csv(f"{PROV}/table_sw_tbc_calibration.csv", index=False)
summ.to_csv(f"{PROV}/table_sw_tbc_summary.csv", index=False)

order = ["Gyp1 (P48365, true TBC)","VirA (Q7BU69, non-TBC GAP)","EspG (Q9AJ34, non-TBC GAP)",
         "LepB (Q5ZSM7, non-TBC GAP)","IpaH4.5 (P18009)"]
cols  = {"Gyp1 (P48365, true TBC)":"#2166ac","VirA (Q7BU69, non-TBC GAP)":"#7fbf7b",
         "EspG (Q9AJ34, non-TBC GAP)":"#7fbf7b","LepB (Q5ZSM7, non-TBC GAP)":"#7fbf7b",
         "IpaH4.5 (P18009)":"#b2182b"}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.2), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[2.1,1]})
for k, q in enumerate(order):
    z = tbc.loc[tbc["query"]==q, "z"].values
    ax[0].scatter(np.full_like(z, k, dtype=float) + np.linspace(-.18,.18,len(z)), np.clip(z, 0.05, None),
                  s=34, color=cols[q], edgecolor="k", linewidth=.4, zorder=3)
    ax[0].plot([k-.3,k+.3],[max(np.median(z),0.05)]*2, color="k", lw=2.2, zorder=4)
ax[0].axhline(5, ls="--", c="grey", lw=1); ax[0].text(4.45, 5.4, "z = 5", color="grey", fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_yscale("log"); ax[0].set_xticks(range(5))
ax[0].set_xticklabels(["Gyp1\ntrue TBC","VirA","EspG","LepB","IpaH4.5"], fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman z against 20 shuffles of the query")
ax[0].set_title("Sequence signal against 24 reviewed TBC-domain proteins\n(bar = median; three non-TBC bacterial RabGAPs shown in green)", fontsize=10)
ax[1].bar([0,1], [nel["z"].median(), tbc.loc[tbc["query"].str.startswith("IpaH4.5"),"z"].median()],
          color=["#762a83","#b2182b"], edgecolor="k")
ax[1].set_yscale("symlog", linthresh=1); ax[1].set_xticks([0,1])
ax[1].set_xticklabels(["vs 5 Salmonella\nNEL-family proteins","vs 24 TBC\nproteins"], fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("median z"); ax[1].set_title("Same test, same null, IpaH4.5 as query:\nit finds real homologs and finds no TBC", fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate([nel["z"].median(), tbc.loc[tbc["query"].str.startswith("IpaH4.5"),"z"].median()]):
    ax[1].text(i, max(v,0.1)*1.4, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
